18 February 2026

Monetary Policy Statement

Monetary Policy Statement, February 2026.

Executive summary

Inflation is projected to average 2.0 per cent in 2026. Economic growth is expected to be 1.2 per cent in 2026.

The New Zealand economy

The New Zealand economy contracted in the December quarter.

The labour market

The unemployment rate is expected to be 5.0 per cent in 2026. Wage growth is projected to be 3.4 per cent in 2026.

Inflation

CPI inflation is projected to average 1.9 per cent in 2027.

Financial conditions

Financial conditions have eased.

Monetary policy

The Committee decided to hold the OCR.

The stance of monetary policy will remain restrictive for as long as necessary.

Risks

Risks to the inflation outlook were broadly balanced. The risks to growth were tilted to the upside.

Annex

Methodology notes on the projections.

Reserve Bank of New Zealand, 2026
